items.a: An AI character — Nana — who reads a chat you upload and writes an honest, funny report about everyone in it: the real dynamic, who cares more, what changed, and everyone's role.
Your first look is free: Nana's opening, the numbers, and the titles of everything in the full report. The full report uses one credit. There's no subscription.
WhatsApp (iPhone and Android), Telegram, LINE and KakaoTalk exports, plus iMessage, Instagram and Messenger through their data exports. Screen-recording import is coming soon.

Nana counts your messages inside your browser first. The upload is encrypted, never shared with anyone in the chat, never sold, and never used to train AI. It's deleted automatically 48 hours after upload if you don't order a report, or 7 days after your latest report.

items.q: Will people in the chat know?
items.a: No. Nobody is notified. A report is only seen by people you send the link to.
Your chat can be in any language or a mix. Reports are written in 24 languages, and Nana uses the chat's own slang.
The preview takes about a minute. The full report about two minutes. We email you when it's ready, so you don't have to wait on the page.
Yes. Under every report you can ask a follow-up question about the same chat. Each answer is a new, deeper report.

items.q: How do I delete my data?
items.a: From 'My chats' you can delete a chat, a report or your whole account at any time.
The numbers are counted exactly from your export. The opinions are Nana's — AI can misread context, so treat it as entertainment, not advice.
Adults (18+) who want a laugh, a reality check, or proof they were right all along.

about.title: About Nana Reads
body: Nana Reads is a small independent studio project. We built a character we wished existed: a grandmother who has read every chat in the world, loves you, and tells you the truth anyway.
Nana reads WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, KakaoTalk, iMessage, Instagram and Messenger chats and writes in 24 languages.
We care about privacy more than anyone in this category: your chat is counted in your browser first, deleted automatically, and never used to train AI.
facts: AI chat reports for friends, couples and families
Free preview, then pay per report. No subscription.
Deleted automatically, never used to train AI
